name: GlobalStorageComponentServerFacet_SetReplicateStorage
summary: The client's storage replication hand-off: the shared two-u64 BE head, then a raw 16-byte run. 32-byte body, C2S. The facet is GlobalStorage, proven by the client's own registration and object-vtable name; the atlas 'Inventories' attribution for 0x183 was wrong. Writer and reader agree field for field and the committed 32-byte record reproduces byte for byte.
purpose: The GlobalStorage facet sets the storage state it wants replicated; the server changes its replicated storage state. The codec (head + 16 raw) is shared by five GlobalStorage wires (SetReplicateStorage, UpdateStorageSession, DebugClearStorage, DebugRequestForcePersistenceDirty, DebugRequestOpenStorageSession), which is why the family row called the shape 'shared by 5 wires'.

created_when: the storage surface is driven and the client pushes its replicated storage state
lifecycle.if_absent: the server never learns the client's storage state

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): typed header 00 01 followed by the prefix varint 83 06, i.e. type_dec 387. A client channel-0 record carries that typed header at offset 24, after the 8-byte frame head and the 16-byte actor id.

fields.name: field_a
fields.note: First of the shared 16-byte head (FUN_1414dbca0). Meaning unnamed. Body offset 0x00.

fields.name: field_b
fields.note: Second head u64; the local-player key 0xbf85314bbc4a951a in the committed body. Body offset 0x08.

fields.name: field_c
fields.note: A raw 16-byte run written by the writer context's slot +0x40 (param_2, object +0x20, 0x10) and read by FUN_1408787b0(object +0x20, 0x10). The atlas does not say GUID, so it is not claimed as one. Body offset 0x10.
